author: c2-sql-edu-critic (independent education critic subagent, fresh context, read-only; rechecked commit f18bccaf)

items.note: The Activity 3 miss feedback now reads "Give NULL a branch of its own, placed first in your CASE", and hint 1 explains why without code. Neither prints the branch.

Partly fixed. Replayed on this page: the starter, a missing comma and a missing semicolon now show "Error", not "Not in this practice editor". A misspelled keyword ("SELEC * FROM students;") still shows "Not in this practice editor" ("This practice editor runs SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE statements; it could not read one starting \"selec\""). The limits list still says that label is "not a sign that your SQL is wrong". The cause is the controller.js EDITOR.check exemption regex, which keeps any message containing "practice editor runs SELECT" as a limit.

Resolved. The Problems marker still names the line after the mistake (a missing semicolon at the end of line 3 shows Ln 4), but the feedback now says "The editor names the line where it noticed the problem; a missing comma or semicolon is often at the end of the line before it". That meets policy 1.3's "says so and names the nearest place to look".
Hint 1 now asks the learner to decide which COALESCE value comes first "so that a recorded city always wins", a reasoning step rather than dictation.
The != option is replaced with NOT (phone = NULL). "o3 no ELSE" now states in its stem that a missing ELSE behaves as ELSE NULL, so it no longer tests an untaught fact.
"o2 stored value" options are now balanced (45 against 44 characters).
At work now says "the data your program sends to a web page".
Resolved. The In interviews row now ends "Activities 1 and 2 practise both".

Partly fixed. The bar now says "Practice editor: imitates PostgreSQL on this page's sample tables, without a real server". Output still opens "(lesson simulator, not real PostgreSQL server)", and after a run that stops with a PostgreSQL ERROR (column "nme" does not exist) the Problems tab still says "No problems found by the lesson checker". The editor still has three names (practice editor, lesson simulator, lesson checker), and the Problems tab and Output still disagree after an ERROR.

Resolved. Confidence reads Guessing / Fairly sure / Certain, and the calibration line echoes "Fairly sure". A wrong guess opens "Not this time; the right answer is marked." The end message reads "Activities 2, 3 and 4 are not done yet".
Resolved. At both 570 and 1280 px the page now loads with scrollY 0 and no hash (go(...) no longer writes the hash on first load), so the topic bar and Topic objectives are on the first screen.
